bio.text: Nnamdi Chukwuocha has represented Delaware House District 1 since 2018.
According to his official page, Chukwuocha is a lifelong Wilmington resident and a former Wilmington city councilman who served as council President Pro Tempore.

The page says he is a licensed master social worker and a veteran of the U.S. Army, and that he holds a bachelor's degree in history and a master of social work degree, both from Delaware State University.
